requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, date, description, and a receipt attachment

criteria.must: An employee can create a claim with amount, category, date, and description
An employee can attach a receipt file to a claim
A submitted claim is rejected if a required field is missing

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of their submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee can view a list of their own claims
Each claim in the list shows its current status (pending, approved, or rejected)

requirements.statement: An employee can edit and resubmit a rejected claim

criteria.must: An employee can edit the fields of a claim that has been rejected
Resubmitting an edited claim changes its status back to pending review
An employee cannot edit a claim that is still pending manager review

requirements.statement: An employee receives an email when their claim is approved or rejected

criteria.must: An email is sent to the employee when their claim is approved
An email is sent to the employee when their claim is rejected

requirements.statement: A manager can see a queue of pending claims from their employees

criteria.must: A manager can view a list of pending claims submitted by their employees
A manager does not see pending claims from employees who are not their reports

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim, changing its status to approved
A manager can reject a pending claim, changing its status to rejected
An employee cannot approve or reject their own claim

requirements.statement: A manager receives an email when a new claim needs their review

criteria.must: An email is sent to the manager when an employee submits a new claim requiring their review

requirements.statement: Finance can see all approved claims

criteria.must: Finance can view a list of all approved claims across employees

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims as a file for payroll

criteria.must: Finance can generate an export file containing approved claims
The exported file is downloadable

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so they are never paid out twice

criteria.must: A claim included in a payroll export is marked as exported
An already-exported claim is not included in a subsequent export
